description: Use this when the user asks a wedding planning or etiquette question: dress codes, invitation wording, traditions, ceremony and reception ideas, or how-to guides. Gives the matching Zola expert advice articles, each with its link. Do not use for how Zola's own products or orders work (use zola_search_help_articles), or when a Zola guide tool answers the question: tipping, gift amounts, who pays, budget, alcohol, or the timelines.

query.description: The wedding planning topic or question, for example 'what does black tie optional mean'

name: zola_search_wedding_advice

results.description: The best Zola expert advice articles, best first

excerpt.description: The part of the article that matches the question

topic.description: The topic of the article, for example 'Fashion & beauty > Wedding attire'

status.description: no_results when no Zola article matches

title: Search Zola Wedding Advice
